title: A 3D-printed hierarchical chimney for high-yield solar evaporation
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01591J, Paper
Yu Tang, Chenyi Fang, Xin Xu, Feng Li, Lei Fan, Di Zhu, Jun Ding, Joseph Imbrogno, Sui Zhang, Wentao Yan
We developed a 3D-printed hierarchical chimney-shaped evaporator to enhance solar evaporation rate and scaling resistance, which leverages the advantages of the chimney-induced directional vapor flow and multi-scale structural features.
